releases.title: v2.0
releases.notes: First public release: fishing core, tournament, self-updater

features.name: BepInEx plugin for friends
features.summary: Windows Defender flags the injector, so friends will get the mod as an r2modman/BepInEx plugin instead of FISHING.exe. The v2 features are ported and packaged as a zip.

features.name: Smoother casting animation
features.summary: Live: an eased wind-up, a flick with overshoot, release at 0.34 s, a curved bobber flight with spin, a splash, bobbing, a dip and tugs on a bite, three skips while reeling, and a 24-point sagging line with rod bend. Gameplay timing is unchanged. Only tested on a dummy rod so far.

features.name: Feature test sandbox
features.summary: !sandbox opens a simple test area (platform, pool, dock, shops). !test <n> sets up one feature with temporary items, money, time and weather, then !note <comment> records feedback. Triage reads each note and marks the feature passed or needs work on the Testing page. Your real items and money are restored when you leave.

features.name: Rod shop: types and skins
features.summary: !shop / !buy / !equip. Rod types (Long Cast, Steady, Quick, Lucky, Golden), 7 rod skins and 5 bobbers that everyone can see.

features.name: Rod held in hand
features.summary: The handle sits in the right fist, and the arm is posed along the rod for each survivor. Live, but the look still needs checking on screen.

features.name: Friends' client gets the new features
features.summary: Right now the new visuals only show on the host. Friends need the rod skins, 3D fish, lighting, underwater view, pets, pools and cases in their build.

features.name: Distinct rod shapes + Stick starter rod
features.summary: Live: 7 rod models (Stick branch, Basic, thin Long Cast with 9 rings, thick Steady, stubby Quick, Lucky with clover and horseshoe, Golden with a gem). All the same length so the hand grip and cast animation still work; skins colour them. The Stick is the free starter (-25% range, 20% slower bites, -20% reel window, -10% rare). Basic now costs $500. The 4 existing players were given a free Basic. Lucky's charms are small.

features.name: Package and publish the next release
features.summary: Choose 2.1 or 3.0, bump the versions, and publish to GitHub and Thunderstore after the host approves.

features.name: Drone pets that auto-fish
features.summary: !pet for $3,000. The drone casts every 20–30 s with worse odds than a player: 70/18/1.9/0.2% vs 54/27/7.2/1.8%, at half value.

features.name: Swimming + breath drowning
features.summary: Live: no instant death. You float neck-deep at 60% speed with splashes. Hold jump to swim up, jump at the edge to climb out, hold X to dive. Breath lasts 60 s floating and 15 s underwater, and refills in 4 s on land. Out of air: −10% HP/s, then you drown after 4 s (normal 10 s respawn). Ghost Fish and ponds don't drain breath. A real out-of-air drowning hasn't happened yet; guests can't swim until the client ships.

features.name: Weather and time-of-day events
features.summary: Rain, golden hour, night and storm change which fish bite and how often, driven by the day/night clock. WeatherTune1 (10 Oct): rain capped at 1,100 particles, pooled ripples (fixes a material leak), lightning cleanup, and darker light during rain (×0.72) and storms (×0.58).

features.name: Eat fish for temporary abilities
features.summary: !eat <fish>: e.g. Minnow speed burst, Salmon triple jump, Ghost Fish walk on water, Golden Koi next catch ×3.

features.name: Underwater view
features.summary: Blue-green fog and tint, the shimmering underside of the surface, and a sandy lake floor with rocks, weeds and bubbles.

features.name: 3D fish
features.summary: All 14 species as 3D models with fins and tail flicks, used for the school, trophies and aquariums.

features.name: Day/night lighting
features.summary: A 10-minute day: morning, day, sunset and a moonlit night with stars, changing the sun, ambient light and fog.

features.name: Physical compass (Shift) + range finder (R)
features.summary: Live: hotspots are invisible but still work. Compass ($1,500): hold Shift and a brass compass rises, with a red needle to the hotspot and a gold needle to the golden one. Range Finder ($3,000): hold R for a 4x zoom with the distance and “- HOTSPOT” when aimed in one. Bought in the stall's Items tab and slotted in the inventory. No real Shift or R press tested yet.

features.name: Fish merchant
features.summary: Live: the Bazaar Newt behind a fish stall by the lake, with an outline and a name tag. Menu within 4.5 m: sell fish (white $15 / green $50 / red $180 / lunar $400), trade fish for cases, buy cases. Chat: !sell, !trade, !case, !skins. Guest side not shipped yet.

features.name: CS:GO-style cases
features.summary: Live: Tackle ($100 / 3 white), Deep Water ($250 / 1 green), Abyssal ($750 / 1 red or lunar). A 5.5 s reel with ticks and a rarity glow. 22 case skins from blue up to gold ★ Legendary Rod / Doppler / Golden Kraken, plus cosmetic wear. Duplicates pay $25–$4,000.

features.name: Flashlight
features.summary: Press L to toggle a spotlight that points where you look. A one-time hint appears when night, rain or a storm starts. Host only for now.

features.name: Inventory with equip slots
features.summary: Live: I or !inv opens it. Eight slots (Rod, Skin, Bobber, Lure, Shift/R gadgets, Pet, Charm), and tabs with rarity-coloured tiles plus E/ST/xN badges and tooltips. Click or drag to equip, right-click to unequip. Fish tiles have Eat and Sell buttons; the Angler's Guide has Use. Real key presses and drags haven't been tested yet; right-clicking a slot still plays the whip animation.

features.name: Rod store stand
features.summary: Live: a market stall by the lake (counter, striped awning, ROD SHOP sign, rods on display in their real skins, outline through walls). Within 4 m the shop list opens; number keys equip, and pressing a number twice buys. !buy only works at the stall; guests buy via [FT] SHOPBUY within 5.5 m.

features.name: Angler's Guide (physical book)
features.summary: Live for Siphoned Forest: a 3D book with page-curl turns, 14 pages, and numbers read from the running game. Changing now: it becomes a cheap ($250) item bought at the rod shop stall that goes into the inventory, and you need to own it to open it. Fixes in progress: the cut-off “Best times” page and hotspot text that matches the compass.

features.name: Custom map: Tropical Island
features.summary: Live: a 190 m island with turquoise shallows, 35 palms, a lagoon, a 45 m dock with tiki torches, a beach hut with a hammock and a campfire, and sea to the horizon. !island / !island leave / !island seed N. The lake, rod shop and merchant move there; the hotspot sits 30 m off the dock. Friends move only after their game confirms it built the island. Tested 3 round trips with the host; fishing there, guests and daylight not tested yet.

features.name: In-game feature voting
features.summary: Every 12 minutes, a 75-second poll offers 3 v3 features. Players vote with !vote 1/2/3; the host also has a poll card and keys 1–3. Commands: !poll, !poll off/on, !poll every <min>. Totals sync to this tracker. The friends' poll card is built but not shipped.

features.name: Lures
features.summary: !lures / !buylure / !lure. Nine lures that favour certain fish, times or maps.

features.name: Rare far-away golden hotspot
features.summary: A second, rarer hotspot 150–300 m from the main one, with better odds, that moves every few minutes.

features.name: Small local pools
features.summary: Shallow ponds around the map with their own fish mix and no drowning.

features.name: Raised lake level (!water)
features.summary: Host command: !water up/down <m>, !water <m>, !water reset. A 10 s warning, then a 12 s rise. Hotspots and guests' water follow, and drowned-respawn spots below the new level are dropped. Saved per map. Siphoned Forest is +6 m.

features.name: Glowing bobbers
features.summary: Live: Glow ($2,500, 25% faster bites at night), Firefly ($4,000, +15% red and lunar at night), Lantern ($6,000, both). Dim by day, bright from 20:00 to 05:00. Not yet tested with a real night catch.

features.name: Cast Distance Tracker (rod upgrade)
features.summary: Live: a $4,000 rod upgrade. While fishing, a bottom strip shows cast distance and bobber-to-hotspot distance (green “in zone!”), plus a landing ring on the water while aiming.

features.name: Time-of-day clock
features.summary: Live: top centre of the screen, with a sun or moon icon, the time and phase (e.g. 19:38 Sunset), a day/night bar, and the current weather with time left.

features.name: StatTrak rods (case-only)
features.summary: Live: 10% of case-only rod skins drop as StatTrak™, which can never be bought. An orange 5-digit counter sits on the rod, and a HUD line shows fish, rare fish and best catch. Only tested with simulated catches so far.

features.name: Personal aquariums
features.summary: !house / !visit / !back: a room with a glass tank of every fish you've caught, swimming in 3D.

features.name: Rare-fish sound
features.summary: A celebration sound for everyone on a red or lunar catch, with a different sound for lunar.

features.name: Umbra fishing duel
features.summary: A dark Umbra copy of you fishes using your own recent stats. Out-fish it to win a reward, or it steals a fish.

features.name: Weaker idle auto-fishing
features.summary: Reel success 70% → 40%, a 20 s idle delay, and no hotspot bonus for auto-caught fish.

features.name: Stinging fish
features.summary: A rare fish (Jellyfish or Stingray) that hurts other players standing near whoever holds it.

features.name: Hook Moby Dick
features.summary: A rare catch hooks Moby Dick instead of a fish: a giant white whale surfaces in the lake and takes a ton of hits to kill (a group boss fight with the rod whip). Replaces the old “hook Mithrix” idea. Open: catch chance, health, what he does to players, and the reward for killing him.

features.name: Pirate raids
features.summary: Every few minutes, 2–4 hostile pirates land at the lake and might steal a fish.

features.name: Fish Wordle
features.summary: A chat word game with fish words. !guess <word>, 6 tries, and the winner gets 5 Wax Quails.

features.name: Jetpack
features.summary: Hold jump in the air to hover. Fuel recharges on the ground. Could be a rare-fish perk.

features.name: Fishing music
features.summary: Calm background music, a catch jingle, and a tense sting on a bite.

features.name: More fish types and variants
features.summary: New species and colour/size variants, to build once the other tasks are done.

features.name: Guide book for more maps
features.summary: Add pages for every other map once the first map's guide is done.

features.name: "$67" popup
features.summary: A big "67!" popup on every screen when a catch is worth exactly $67.

features.name: Magma worms for everyone
features.summary: Extend a player's Magma Worm prank to everyone at a lower chance, about 1 in 20.

features.name: Tickle Fish
features.summary: A fish that plays a laugh, shows HAHAHA over you and makes you wiggle.

features.name: Innkeeper worm joke catch
features.summary: A rare junk catch: a pink sausage-shaped worm with a funny chat line.

features.name: A player drops bombs
features.summary: Every ~15 s a player drops a bomb that hurts players nearby for about 10%. Not lethal.

features.name: Harpoon for a player
features.summary: A long-range right-click harpoon that pulls the target closer and cancels their line.

features.name: Roulette table
features.summary: Bet fish on red, black or a number. Replaced by the fish merchant and cases.

features.name: Fishing core: cast, reel, catchable school
features.summary: Lobbed casts up to 200 m into the lake, bite and reel timing, a visible school of fish where casting closer means better odds, 14 species in the item bar.

features.name: Drowning with 10 s respawn
features.summary: Death means spectate, except drowning: you respawn on dry land after 10 seconds.

features.name: Purple hotspot
features.summary: A purple teleporter-sparkle hotspot with better odds, kept on open water within reach of land. Next release: the markers get hidden and the compass + range finder take their place.

features.name: Map-select podium ring
features.summary: A ring of podiums by the lake to vote on the next map.

features.name: Moon Eel free revive
features.summary: Holding a Moon Eel gives one free revive.

features.name: Peaceful fish-only mode
features.summary: No monsters, no weapons, no chests or items. Only fish, whose perks are weaker than real items.

features.name: Pranks: Magma Worm, Poop, Old Boot
features.summary: 1 in 4 of a player's catches spawns a Magma Worm, and the Old Boot shows a fake +2% luck. The Poop catch (−$1,000,000) was removed on 10 Oct (Pranks2).

features.name: F2 request panel
features.summary: Players send feature requests from in game, and the host approves or logs them.

features.name: 10-minute tournament
features.summary: Fresh start, a new map every 2 minutes, and the winner takes everyone's lunar coins.

features.name: FISHING.exe self-updater
features.summary: The guest client for friends, with a SHA-256-checked auto-update and a download-latest button. Public repo Joeyvolcic/ror2-fishing.

features.name: Wavy lake water
features.summary: The lake uses the Gilded Coast sea material, so it has real waves.

features.name: Rod Whip with Merc swing
features.summary: Right click whips nearby players for 1 damage and cancels their line. 20 m range, 60° cone, bigger rods with a slower right-to-left Merc-style swing.
